styles.label: Claymorphism
styles.description: Soft, tactile, sculpted surfaces with friendly depth.
styles.recommended_for: Playful consumer experiences, creative tools, personal dashboards.

styles.label: Glassmorphism
styles.description: Translucent layered planes with crisp content.
styles.recommended_for: Marketing microsites, media interfaces, hero sections and light dashboards.

styles.label: Brutalism
styles.description: Raw structure, unapologetic hierarchy, minimal decoration.
styles.recommended_for: Experimental portfolios, art/culture, activist/editorial sites, distinctive landing pages.

styles.label: Neo-brutalism
styles.description: Playful bold colors, hard borders and offset shadows.
styles.recommended_for: Creator tools, playful SaaS, event or indie product websites.

styles.label: Minimalism
styles.description: Purposeful restraint with high information clarity.
styles.recommended_for: Productivity tools, storefronts, portfolios, form-centric products.

styles.label: Swiss / Editorial
styles.description: Grid-driven typographic hierarchy and intentional rhythm.
styles.recommended_for: Magazines, agencies, portfolios, reports and information-rich marketing sites.

styles.label: Bento Grid
styles.description: Modular card composition with varied, purposeful panel sizes.
styles.recommended_for: Product overviews, portfolios, landing pages and feature discovery.

styles.label: Skeuomorphism
styles.description: Digital controls borrow useful affordances from physical objects.
styles.recommended_for: Music tools, specialized controls, educational simulations and playful product interfaces.

styles.label: Retro Terminal
styles.description: Developer-console visual language with modern usability.
styles.recommended_for: Developer portfolios, CLI dashboards, cyberculture experiences and coding tools.

styles.label: Enterprise / Data-first
styles.description: Efficient professional interfaces designed for repeated workflows.
styles.recommended_for: Admin consoles, B2B SaaS, trading and logistics operations, dashboards.
